tools.name: what_to_wear_today
tools.description: Clothing layers to wear today in a city, from today's weather forecast (Open-Meteo). Generic advice; the app personalizes it with the user's own closet.

tools.name: travel_packing_list
tools.description: Capsule packing list for a trip (destination + number of days) based on the destination's forecast. Generic; the app builds it from the user's own closet with one outfit per day and plan.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_product_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
